answers.question: Did the agent stay on the shift offer without inventing other topics as facts?
answers.quote: Thanks for asking, but I can only share details about this shift right now. So, the wound care shift is Monday night to Tuesday morning for $40 an hour in Jersey City. Are you interested in taking it?

answers.question: Did the agent close politely when the nurse had to go?
answers.quote: Thanks for letting me know. I appreciate you considering the shift, and it was great catching up. Have a wonderful day!
